name: arith_odd_perfect_euler_form
statement: (n : ℕ) (ho : Odd n) (hp : n.Perfect) : ∃ p a m : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p % 4 = 1 ∧ a % 4 = 1 ∧ ¬ p ∣ m ∧ n = p ^ a * m ^ 2
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (ho : Odd n) (hp : n.Perfect), ∃ p a m : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ p % 4 = 1 ∧ a % 4 = 1 ∧ ¬ p ∣ m ∧ n = p ^ a * m ^ 2
informal: Euler's theorem on odd perfect numbers: n = p^a m² with p ≡ a ≡ 1 (mod 4), p ∤ m — σ(n) = 2n ≡ 2 (mod 4), so exactly one factor σ(q^e) is even and it is ≡ 2 mod 4; σ(q^e) for odd q is odd iff e even, and ≡ 2 mod 4 forces q ≡ e ≡ 1 mod 4.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), Odd n → n.Perfect → ∃ p a m, Nat.Prime p ∧ p % 4 = 1 ∧ a % 4 = 1 ∧ ¬p ∣ m ∧ n = p ^ a * m ^ 2
